matrix.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `float64`, `float32`, `half`, `complex64`, `complex128`. Shape is `[..., M, M]`.
constraints: matrix must be one of float64, float32, half, complex64, complex128

rhs.description: A `Tensor`. Must have the same type as `matrix`. Shape is `[..., M, K]`.
constraints: rhs must have the same dtype as matrix

adjoint.description: An optional `bool`. Defaults to `False`. Boolean indicating whether to solve with `matrix` or its (block-wise) adjoint.

output.description: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `matrix`.
